channel.title: Park alerts for Sunshine Coast
channel.description: Changes to conditions in Queensland's national parks, marine parks and forests - Sunshine Coast.

item.title: Wet weather access Conondale National Park (update)
item.description: As a result of wet weather, access is restricted, and some areas are closed until declared safe. Affected parks: Imbil State Forest; Conondale National Park

item.title: Temporary closure of shared trails and mountain bike trails- Tewantin NP and Parklands CP
item.description: Due to current rainfall on saturated ground, all mountain bike trails within Tewantin National Park (Wooroi section) and Parklands Conservation Park are closed between Thursday 22 October and Tuesday 27 October, 2026. Affected parks: Parklands Conservation Park; Tewantin National Park

item.title: Kondalilla National Park - Wet Weather Access
item.description: As a result of wet weather, access is restricted and some areas are closed until declared safe. Affected parks: Kondalilla National Park

item.title: Mount Beerwah temporarily closed
item.description: Mount Beerwah is temporarily closed due to recent heavy rainfall. All access routes on Mount Beerwah are closed as a precautionary measure following significant rainfall events, as the risk of rockfall is considerably higher. Affected parks: Glass House Mountains National Park

item.title: Ewen Maddock mountain Bike trail temporarily closed
item.description: The Ewen Maddock Mountain Bike Trail is currently heavily waterlogged due to recent wet weather. To prevent further trail damage, QPWS requests that riders avoid using the trail until conditions improve and sufficient dry weather has allowed the ground to recover. Affected parks: Beerburrum and Beerwah State Forests

item.title: Access to Amamoor State Forest and Brooyar State Forest
item.description: There has been some moderate rainfall over the past week in the Amamoor Creek and Glastonbury Creek catchment areas. Current forecast is for rain to continue over the rest of the week and into next week. Drivers should slow down, stop, check and assess conditions on the road before deciding if it is safe to traverse. Please remember - If it’s flooded, forget it! Some creek crossings may still be inundated. Please observe all signage, barriers and directions from rangers and do not enter closed areas. Please visit this park's page on the department website for more park safety information. Affected parks: Brooyar State Forest; Amamoor State Forest

item.title: Drive with care during marine turtle nesting season
item.description: From November to May, you may see turtles crossing the beach to lay their eggs or hatchlings making their way to the water for the first time. Motorists and visitors to the Cooloola and K’gari recreation areas within Great Sandy National Park, and the Inskip Peninsula Recreation Area, are asked to minimise disturbance and human impacts on nesting marine turtles and emerging hatchlings Affected parks: Inskip Peninsula Recreation Area; Cooloola Recreation Area, Great Sandy National Park; K'gari, Great Sandy National Park

item.title: Woondum National Park wet weather road closures
item.description: As a result of wet weather, access is restricted, and some areas are closed until declared safe. Affected parks: Woondum National Park

item.title: Drive with care during marine turtle nesting season
item.description: From November to May, you may see turtles crossing the beach to lay their eggs or hatchlings making their way to the water for the first time. Motorists and visitors to Bribie Island National Park and Recreation Area are asked to minimise disturbance and human impacts to nesting marine turtles. Affected parks: Bribie Island National Park and Recreation Area

item.title: Seasonal closure – Cooloola Great Walk
item.description: The Cooloola Great Walk, including all associated walkers' camps, will be seasonally closed from 1 December 2026 to 28 February 2027. Affected parks: Cooloola Recreation Area, Great Sandy National Park; Cooloola Great Walk

item.title: Planned Works for Stony Creek Day Use Area Access Road
item.description: Moreton Bay City Council are conducting upgrades to Fletcher Road, which provides access to Stony Creek Day Use Area, over the next 3 weeks (weather permitting) Affected parks: Bellthorpe National Park

item.title: Safety Alert - Fallen trees and planned works on Conondale Range Great Walk (update 29 Sep)
item.description: Queensland Parks and Wildlife Service (QPWS) will be conducting a maintenance program on the Conondale Range Great Walk from 1 May to 30 November (weather permitting). Affected parks: Imbil State Forest; Conondale National Park; Conondale Range Great Walk

item.title: Ex HMAS Tobruk public mooring temporary closed (update 28 Sep)
item.description: Visitors are advised that the Ex HMAS Tobruk public mooring is temporarily closed due to mooring line repairs. Affected parks: Great Sandy Marine Park

item.title: Inskip hazardous trees and campground maintenance - Temporary closures (update)
item.description: Planned site rehabilitation, maintenance and hazardous tree works in the Inskip Peninsula Recreation Area will commence Monday 26th 2026 October until Friday 12th March 2027. Affected parks: Inskip Peninsula Recreation Area

item.title: Pest Control Program in Cooloola Recreation Area
item.description: QPWS rangers and contractors will be conducting a feral animal control program from 31 October 2026 through to 28 November 2026 within the Teewah Beach and Freshwater camping areas. Firearms, poisons or traps may be in use. Affected parks: Cooloola Recreation Area, Great Sandy National Park

item.title: Water across Cooloola Wilderness Trail
item.description: Walkers on the Cooloola Wilderness Trail are advised of water across the track in multiple sections Affected parks: Cooloola Recreation Area, Great Sandy National Park

item.title: Glass House Mountains Lookout BBQ Closure
item.description: Glass House Mountains Lookout day use area no longer has BBQ's facilities. Affected parks: Beerburrum and Beerwah State Forests

item.title: Ex-HMAS Brisbane Public Mooring closed post severe weather event (cyclone Alfred). Public access to ex-HMAS Brisbane remains closed. (update)
item.description: Ex-HMAS Brisbane Public Mooring closed post severe weather event (cyclone Alfred). Public access to ex-HMAS Brisbane remains closed. Affected parks: Ex-HMAS Brisbane Conservation Park

item.title: Planned works for Parklands Conservation Park
item.description: Queensland Parks and Wildlife Service (QPWS) will be conducting planned maintenance at Parklands Conservation Park from 4 August 2026 to 31 October 2026 (weather permitting). Affected parks: Parklands Conservation Park

item.title: Permanent fire prohibition on Teewah Beach (update 3 Jul)
item.description: A QPWS imposed fire prohibition is in place in the Cooloola Recreation Area, except at Poverty Point camping area. Camp fires must not be lit anywhere else in the recreation area including in the Teewah Beach camping zones 1-7. Affected parks: Cooloola Recreation Area, Great Sandy National Park

item.title: SEVERE EROSION – Inskip barge landing beach access tracks (update 30 Jun)
item.description: Severe erosion has occurred at the Inskip barge landing beach access tracks due to natural coastal processes and ongoing tidal inundation. Affected parks: Inskip Peninsula Recreation Area; K'gari Great Walk; K'gari, Great Sandy National Park

item.title: Mt Allan fire tower closed to climbing (update 8 Jun)
item.description: Mt Allan fire tower in Conondale National Park is temporarily closed to climbing. An engineering report has indicated the tower is not suitable for public access. The tower will be closed to all access until further notice. Affected parks: Imbil State Forest; Conondale National Park; Conondale Range Great Walk

item.title: Natural Sand Movement and access to Double Island Point (update 28 May)
item.description: Deep hole formations which may restrict access to and from Double Island Point Affected parks: Cooloola Recreation Area, Great Sandy National Park

item.title: Exposed sand cliff and dune landslide danger (update)
item.description: Exposed sand cliffs and dunes along Teewah Beach, Rainbow Beach and Double Island Point are unstable and can collapse without warning. Affected parks: Cooloola Recreation Area, Great Sandy National Park

item.title: Partial Park closure – Cooloola Wilderness Trail: no pedestrian access across Kin Kin Creek
item.description: The Kin Kin Creek pedestrian bridge, which links Elanda Point to Figtree Point on the Cooloola Wilderness Trail, has been washed away during previous flood events. As a result, there is no pedestrian access across Kin Kin Creek currently. Affected parks: Cooloola Recreation Area, Great Sandy National Park; Cooloola (Noosa River) Resources Reserve

item.title: Camp site booking restrictions due to tidal inundation (update 8 Jan)
item.description: Several low-lying camp sites adjacent to Pumicestone Passage on the western side of Bribie Island Recreation Area will be closed on a recurring basis throughout 2026 due to tidal inundation from forecast large high tides. Affected parks: Bribie Island National Park and Recreation Area

item.title: Inskip Peninsula camping area boundary realignment and access changes following severe weather damage, combined with shoreline retrogression (update)
item.description: A combination of ex-Tropical Cyclone Alfred damage, storm surges, swell, and shoreline retrogression has eroded the eastern-facing beaches of Inskip Peninsula, and caused loss of sand, destabilisation of the dunes and loss of existing campground border fencing. Affected parks: Inskip Peninsula Recreation Area
